name: Pineapple
detailed_description:
Pineapple: A Tropical Tapping Adventure


Get ready for an addictive clicker experience where every tap brings a burst of tropical fun! In Pineapple, your mission is simple: click on the pineapple and watch your collection grow as you uncover a world of rare and extraordinary pineapples.


How It Works
Every two hours, receive a mystery pineapple drop from our exclusive pool. With each drop carrying its own unique rarity, every click is a chance at greatness!


2-Hour Drop Pool Odds:
• Normal: 70%
• Common: 25%
• Uncommon: 4.89%
• Rare: 0.1%
• Epic: 0.01%
• Ultra Rare: 1 in 200,000
• Legendary: 1 in 5,000,000
Odds are subject to change as we continually update the game for maximum excitement!


Every 12 hours, receive a drop of Rare rarity or higher.


Features:
• Endless Pineapple Tapping: Enjoy the exhilarating simplicity of tapping your way to a growing collection.
• Diverse and Distinct Pineapples: Collect everything from the everyday tropical delight to the ultra-rare gems that few have seen.

Are you ready to embrace the pineapple frenzy? Join the community, refine your tapping skills, and become the ultimate pineapple connoisseur. Start clicking and let the tropical adventure begin!
